assets.name: 薄鹽鯖魚
assets.sourceType: AI-generated demo illustration; not supplier photography
assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: demo seafood ordering catalogue product image, illustrative photography rather than an actual supplier photo.

Style/medium: realistic natural food catalogue photography with true-to-life fish anatomy and raw textures.
Composition/framing: 4:3 landscape image, overhead at a slight angle, centered complete subject with generous breathing room around every edge, full tray visible; one coherent photograph.

Primary request: thin lightly salted mackerel fillets (薄鹽鯖魚).
Subject: two slender raw mackerel fillets arranged simply side by side, one mostly skin-side up displaying silver-blue skin with characteristic dark wavy stripes, the second flesh-side up with pale moist raw flesh and a narrow visible striped skin edge; anatomically natural fish fillets, lightly salted without a visible heap of salt. Uncooked and unbrowned.
